block: The slug module implementing the slugify(text: str) -> str function that converts any text string into a URL-safe slug containing only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.

vocabulary.definition: A URL-safe identifier composed of lowercase letters (a-z), digits (0-9), and hyphens, used as the output of the slugify function
A maximal sequence of alphanumeric characters separated by whitespace or special characters
A location in text where words are separated by whitespace or non-alphanumeric characters
Whitespace or non-alphanumeric characters that act as word boundaries and are converted to hyphens in output

units.name: slugify
units.holds: Returns a URL-safe string containing only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, with words in original order and no leading or trailing hyphens

invariants.claim: Output contains only characters from VALID_SLUG_CHARSET: lowercase a-z, digits 0-9, and hyphen
Words in output appear in the same relative order as they appear in input
All alphabetic characters in output are lowercase (a-z), never uppercase (A-Z)
Output does not begin with a hyphen character
Output does not end with a hyphen character
Output does not contain consecutive hyphen characters (no -- substrings)
Whitespace characters in input act as word boundaries and separate words with hyphens in output
Non-alphanumeric characters and punctuation marks do not appear in output (except hyphen)
Non-ASCII input characters are not transliterated or converted to ASCII equivalents

negative.must_not: Import or depend on third-party packages; only Python standard library is used
Implement transliteration logic that converts non-ASCII characters to ASCII substitutes

failure.observable: TypeError exception is raised with message indicating type error

failure.on: Input argument is not a string type (int, list, dict, etc.)
failure.observable: TypeError exception is raised with message indicating type error

steps.text: Validate that input is a string type; raise TypeError if input is None or not a string
Convert input string to lowercase using standard string case conversion
Replace each non-alphanumeric character (excluding existing hyphens) with a space to identify word boundaries; non-ASCII characters are removed or converted to separators without transliteration
Split the processed string on whitespace characters to extract individual words
Join non-empty words with single hyphen separators, maintaining word order from input
Remove any leading or trailing hyphen characters from the result string
Verify that all characters in output conform to VALID_SLUG_CHARSET
